decisions.approved_rule: Function codes attach to dated actions or relations, never to a fixed pro-U.S./anti-U.S. actor property.

Use LEG0 for service/resource facts, LEG1 for actor-authored intent or narrative, LEG2 for bounded recipient/local/independent reception or contestation, and LEG3 for repeatable attitude/behavior/institutional effects under an explicit design.
